verdict.rationale: Slate has a local `/workspace` manager for adding and removing workspace directories, and it reads agent rules and skills files kept in the repo (such as `.claude/skills/`). A team could commit those files so everyone shares the same instructions, but the evidence only implies this and never presents it as a team feature. missing for 10: any documented shared or team workspace, combining docs and repos into one team-accessible source of truth, collaboration or sharing controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
